1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2.  The application is disposed of.

3. By way of the present application, the applicant seeks anticipatory bail in FIR No. 376/2023 dated 26th August, 2023, under Sections 376/506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (IPC) registered at Police Station Amar Colony.
4. Senior counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant submits that the applicant was in a consensual relationship with the prosecutrix since 2019 and the FIR has been filed belatedly.

sentences.text: 6. Learned APP appearing on behalf of the State submits that in the present case the applicant had misrepresented to the prosecutrix that he was getting a divorce from his first wife and therefore, no FIR was lodged by the prosecutrix.

It is submitted that another FIR being FIR No. 270/2023 under Sections 498A/494 of the IPC has been instituted by the first wife of the applicant in Hyderabad,
Telangana.
7. Issue notice.
8. Notice is accepted by the learned APP appearing on behalf of the State.
9. Status Report be filed.

10. List on 7th November, 2023.
